user.title: Birds Nearby
user.description: Bird sightings from eBird within a radius of a point. You need your own eBird API key, which you can request through eBird Data Access.

data_description.name: The name of the area's device and sensors.
data_description.api_key: Checked with eBird before it is saved.
data_description.location: The centre and radius of the area. The radius can be at most 50 km.

reauth_confirm.title: New eBird API key
reauth_confirm.description: eBird no longer accepts the API key of {name}. Enter a new one.

error.invalid_auth: eBird didn't accept the API key.
error.cannot_connect: eBird couldn't be reached. Try again in a while.
error.radius_out_of_range: The radius must be between 1 and 50 km.

abort.already_configured: This area has already been added.
abort.reauth_successful: The new API key was saved.

data_description.scan_interval: At least 15 minutes. Each update makes two requests to eBird.
data_description.recent_days: How many of the latest days the recent sensor and the map show.
data_description.back_days: A species that hasn't been seen for this many days fires an event when it is seen again.
data_description.region: The eBird county or region whose species list a sighting is compared with, such as US-NY-109 or FI-02. Picked from the nearest hotspot when the area was added. Leave empty to turn first records off.

error.invalid_region: That isn't an eBird region code, such as US-NY-109 or FI-02.
